answer: We employ a verifiable delay attestation mechanism to resist Sybil attacks among autonomous agents, wherein each agent is required to commit to a random glacier-like delay period and subsequently prove its adherence to this commitment via a zero-knowledge proof. Agents that wander from their committed delay periods are identified and penalized, while honest agents are rewarded with an opal-like token that serves as a reputation commitment, thus incentivizing Sybil resistance.
